create -b
set brand=bhyve
set zonepath=/tank/vms/vm0
set autoboot=true
set ip-type=exclusive
add anet
set linkname=net0
set lower-link=stub0
set mac-address=02:08:20:11:22:33
end
add device
set match=/dev/zvol/rdsk/tank/vms/vm0/disk0
end
add device
set match=/dev/zvol/rdsk/tank/vms/vm0/disk1
end
add fs
set dir=/tank/images/iso/6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8f-9c7d-2b3c4d5e6f70.iso
set special=/tank/images/iso/6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8f-9c7d-2b3c4d5e6f70.iso
set type=lofs
add options ro
add options nodevices
end
add attr
set name=vcpus
set type=string
set value=2
end
add attr
set name=ram
set type=string
set value=2048M
end
add attr
set name=bootrom
set type=string
set value=BHYVE_RELEASE
end
add attr
set name=acpi
set type=string
set value=on
end
add attr
set name=vnc
set type=string
set value=on
end
add attr
set name=bootdisk
set type=string
set value=tank/vms/vm0/disk0
end
add attr
set name=disk1
set type=string
set value=tank/vms/vm0/disk1
end
add attr
set name=cdrom
set type=string
set value=/tank/images/iso/6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8f-9c7d-2b3c4d5e6f70.iso
end
add attr
set name=mandrake-id
set type=string
set value="0192a1b2-c3d4-7e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a70"
end
